summary: Brookfield Oaktree Holdings filed an 8-K reporting completion of the Transactions under a Transaction Agreement dated April 14, 2026. All outstanding limited partnership interests and equity awards of OCGH, OEP, and OEP II were acquired or cancelled in exchange for consideration including cash, BAM and BN shares, ExchangeCo interests, and BAM RSUs. Brookfield US Company LLC purchased assets from OCH. No deal price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The structure involves multiple Brookfield entities and ExchangeCo rollover. Watch for any subsequent valuation or regulatory details.
